I hear she has moved away.
The judge will hear the case today.

dict_mnemonic.text: hear 是「听见」，消息进了耳朵就成了「听说」；法庭先把话听完，所以 hear 又表示「审理」。

root: 来自古英语 hieran（听、听从），与 ear 同源；由耳朵察觉声音，引申为接收消息，再用于法庭听取案件。

sensesIntro.en: Hear runs from a sound reaching the ear, to news reaching the mind, to a court listening to a case.
sensesIntro.cn: hear 从声音抵达耳朵，走到消息抵达心里，再走到法庭听取案件。

core.en: A bell ringing somewhere out of sight.
core.cn: 看不见的地方有钟在响。

branches.en: A bell reaches the ear.
branches.cn: 钟声传到耳朵里。

branches.en: A friend passes on the news.
branches.cn: 朋友把消息转告过来。

branches.en: A judge listens to both sides.
branches.cn: 法官听取双方陈述。

branches.en: A sound becomes a story.
branches.cn: 一个声音，变成一段故事。

branches.en: To judge well, one must hear fully.
branches.cn: 要判得公道，先听得完整。

intro.en: Hear takes verb endings and builds hearing, agent, and negative forms.
intro.cn: hear 加动词词尾，并构成听觉、施动者与否定形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 我无意中听到了他们的谈话。

items.example: I hope to hear from you.
Did you hear about the fire?

definition_en: the organ that pumps blood, the center of feeling, or the most important part of something
core_image: 胸腔里一颗不断收缩舒张的器官，也是情感的中心
scene: 他心脏跳得很快。His heart was beating fast.
sceneCN: 这里 heart 是「心脏」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他心脏跳得很快。

senses.title: The organ
senses.definition: the organ in the chest that pumps blood
senses.definitionCN: 胸腔内推动血液循环的器官
senses.example: His heart was beating fast.
senses.why: This is the physical organ.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体里的实体器官。

senses.title: The center of feeling
senses.definition: the place where deep feelings are felt
senses.definitionCN: 深层情感所在之处
senses.example: She knew in her heart that he was right.
senses.why: The organ becomes the seat of emotion.
senses.whyCN: 器官在这里成了情感的座位。

senses.title: The central part
senses.definition: the most important or central part of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物最重要或最中心的部位
senses.example: The hotel is in the heart of the city.
senses.why: What is central is as vital as the organ.
senses.whyCN: 处在中心的东西，和心脏一样要紧。

intro.en: Heart comes from Old English heorte, the organ and the mind.
intro.cn: heart 来自古英语 heorte，兼指器官与心智。

items.en: Heorte named the physical heart.
items.cn: heorte 指身体里的心脏。

items.en: The same root named the heart in related tongues.
items.cn: 同源语言里也有相应的「心」字。

items.en: Herte also meant courage and feeling.
items.cn: 中古英语 herte 也指勇气与情感。

items.en: The word moved to the center of places and things.
items.cn: 这个词又移到地点与事物的中心。

items.en: By heart came to mean from memory.
items.cn: by heart 固定为凭记忆的意思。

note.en: Heart is compared with look-alike words and with words for a center.
note.cn: 把 heart 与形近词以及表示中心的词作比较。

entries.definition: the deep self of a person

normalIntro.en: Heart starts as muscle and ends up meaning the middle of everything.
normalIntro.cn: heart 从一块肌肉开始，最后成了一切的中枢。

normal.en: His heart beat faster.
She has a kind heart.
I learned the poem by heart.
The shop sits in the heart of town.
Take heart and try again.

abstract.en: The heart is the body's first clock.
abstract.cn: 心脏是身体里的第一只钟。

abstract.en: What we love, we say we hold in the heart.
abstract.cn: 所爱之物，我们总说放在心里。

abstract.en: Every city has a heart that keeps beating.
abstract.cn: 每座城市都有一颗持续跳动的心。

examples.en: His heart was beating fast.
She knew in her heart that he was right.
The hotel is in the heart of the city.

dict_mnemonic.text: heart 既指「心脏」，也指「内心」，因为古人把情感放在心里；由此再引申为「核心」，by heart 则是把东西放进心里，也就是背下来。

root: 来自古英语 heorte（心脏），与拉丁语 cor、希腊语 kardia 同源；由器官引申为情感与勇气的所在，再引申为事物的中心与核心。

sensesIntro.en: Heart moves from the pumping organ to the seat of feeling to the middle of a place.
sensesIntro.cn: heart 从泵血的器官，走到情感的座位，再走到地点的中心。

core.en: A muscle beating in the dark of the chest.
core.cn: 胸腔暗处一块不停跳动的肌肉。

branches.en: The pulse quickens after a run.
branches.cn: 跑完步，脉搏加快。

branches.en: A letter is kept for years.
branches.cn: 一封信被珍藏多年。

branches.en: The square is full of shops and people.
branches.cn: 广场上满是店铺与人。

branches.en: The organ beats faster when we feel deeply.
branches.cn: 情深时，这颗器官跳得更快。

branches.en: The middle of a town feels like its feeling.
branches.cn: 城镇的中心，像它的心绪所在。

intro.en: Heart builds adjectives, adverbs, and compound nouns.
intro.cn: heart 构成形容词、副词与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is cor, as in cordial and courage.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 cor，见于 cordial 与 courage。

items.example: She knows the song by heart.

definition_en: the quality of being hot, the act of making something hot, or strong excitement
core_image: 正午的柏油路面蒸腾出扭曲的热气
scene: 正午的太阳热得烫人。The heat of the noon sun was fierce.
sceneCN: 这里 heat 是「高温」（第 1 个义项）；句意：正午的太阳热得烫人。

senses.title: High temperature
senses.definition: the quality of being hot
senses.definitionCN: 物体或环境热的程度
senses.example: The heat of the noon sun was fierce.
senses.why: This is the physical warmth itself.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理意义上的热。

senses.title: Make hot
senses.definition: to make something hot
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变热
senses.example: Heat the soup before serving.
senses.why: The word turns from a state into an action.
senses.whyCN: 词性从状态变成了动作。

senses.title: Strong excitement
senses.definition: strong feeling or activity at its peak
senses.definitionCN: 情绪或活动最高涨的时刻
senses.example: He said it in the heat of the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 他在争论最激烈时说了那句话。
senses.why: Anger is described as fire.
senses.whyCN: 愤怒被比作火。

intro.en: Heat comes from Old English hætu, the state of being hot.
intro.cn: heat 来自古英语 hætu，意为热的状态。

items.en: Hætu named hotness or a hot season.
items.cn: hætu 指热或炎热的季节。

items.en: It shared a root with hot.
items.cn: 它与 hot 共用一个词根。

items.en: Hete kept the sense of high temperature.
items.cn: 中古英语 hete 仍指高温。

items.en: Heat became a verb meaning to make hot.
items.cn: heat 变成动词，表示加热。

items.en: The heat of an argument named its peak.
items.cn: 争论之热，指其最激烈的时刻。

note.en: Heat is compared with look-alike words and with words for warmth.
note.cn: 把 heat 与形近词以及表示温暖的词作比较。

entries.definition: how hot or cold something is

normalIntro.en: Heat is warmth you can measure, and anger you can feel.
normalIntro.cn: heat 是量得出来的热，也是感觉得到的怒火。

normal.en: The heat was hard to bear.
Heat the milk gently.
A heat wave hit the city.
The engine gives off heat.
In the heat of the moment, he quit.
normal.cn: 一时冲动之下，他辞职了。

abstract.en: Heat is motion hidden inside matter.
abstract.cn: 热，是藏在物质内部的运动。

abstract.en: Fire warms the hands and warns the eyes.
abstract.cn: 火暖手，也警告眼睛。

abstract.en: Anger is heat without a chimney.
abstract.cn: 愤怒，是没有烟囱的热。

examples.en: The heat of the noon sun was fierce.
Heat the soup before serving.
He said it in the heat of the argument.
examples.cn: 他在争论最激烈时说了那句话。

dict_mnemonic.text: heat 与 hot 同源，本指「热」；把东西弄热就是「加热」，情绪烧到最旺就是「激烈」，如 in the heat of 这一说法。

root: 来自古英语 hætu（热、炎热），与 hot 同源；由物理上的高温，引申出加热的动作，再比喻情绪或争斗的最高点。

sensesIntro.en: Heat is a hot state, the act of making hot, and the peak of strong feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: heat 是热的状态、加热的动作，以及强烈情绪的最高点。

core.en: Air shaking above hot asphalt.
core.cn: 滚烫柏油路上方颤动的空气。

branches.en: The pavement burns underfoot.
branches.cn: 路面烫着脚底。

branches.en: A pot steams on the stove.
branches.cn: 炉子上的锅冒着热气。

branches.en: Voices rise in a quarrel.
branches.cn: 争吵中声音越来越高。

branches.en: We add heat to cook, and cooking gives heat.
branches.cn: 我们加热来做饭，做饭又生出热。

branches.en: A heated talk can burn like a stove.
branches.cn: 激烈的谈话，能像炉子一样烫。

intro.en: Heat takes verb endings and builds tools, nouns, and new verbs.
intro.cn: heat 加动词词尾，并构成器具、名词与新动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 他们进行了一场激烈的辩论。

items.meaning: the system that warms a home

items.example: A heat wave lasted a week.

definition_en: to lift or pull something heavy with effort, to rise and fall, or to throw something
core_image: 一个人弯腰抱住重箱，憋气把它抬离地面
scene: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
sceneCN: 这里 heave 是「举起」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。

senses.title: Lift with effort
senses.definition: to lift or pull something heavy with great effort
senses.definitionCN: 费力地抬起或拉动重物
senses.example: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。
senses.why: This is effort applied to weight.
senses.whyCN: 这是把力气用在重量上。

senses.title: Rise and fall
senses.definition: to move up and down in a heavy way
senses.definitionCN: 沉重地上下起伏
senses.example: His chest heaved as he ran.
senses.exampleCN: 他跑步时胸口剧烈起伏。
senses.why: Breath and waves rise and fall.
senses.whyCN: 呼吸与波浪都一起一伏。

senses.title: Throw something
senses.definition: to throw something heavy
senses.definitionCN: 用力扔出沉重的东西
senses.example: They heaved the rope over the wall.
senses.why: Throwing is lifting and letting go.
senses.whyCN: 抛出，就是抬起再放手。

intro.en: Heave comes from Old English hebban, to lift.
intro.cn: heave 来自古英语 hebban，意为举起。

items.en: Hebban meant to lift or raise.
items.cn: hebban 意为举起、抬起。

items.en: The root also named the sky, the lifted roof.
items.cn: 这个词根也构成「天空」，即抬起的天顶。

items.en: Heven kept the sense of lifting heavily.
items.cn: 中古英语 heven 仍指费力抬起。

items.en: Heave described the rise and fall of waves.
items.cn: heave 用来描写波浪起伏。

items.en: A sigh is something the chest heaves out.
items.cn: 叹气，是胸腔把气抬出去。

note.en: Heave is compared with look-alike words and with words for lifting.
note.cn: 把 heave 与形近词以及表示举起的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heave is effort made visible in a lifted weight.
normalIntro.cn: heave 是力气在重量上显出的形状。

normal.en: They heaved the log onto the fire.
He heaved a deep sigh.
The sea heaved in the storm.
normal.cn: 暴风雨里大海起伏翻涌。

normal.en: She heaved the bag onto her shoulder.
The ship heaved into view.

abstract.en: To heave is to argue with gravity.
abstract.cn: 用力举起，就是和重力讲道理。

abstract.en: A sigh is the chest letting go.
abstract.cn: 一声叹息，是胸腔在放手。

abstract.en: Waves heave because the sea is breathing.
abstract.cn: 波浪起伏，因为海在呼吸。

examples.en: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
examples.cn: 他们把沉重的箱子抬上了卡车。

examples.en: His chest heaved as he ran.
examples.cn: 他跑步时胸口剧烈起伏。

examples.en: They heaved the rope over the wall.

dict_mnemonic.text: heave 的核心是「用力抬」；抬重物是举起，胸口一起一伏是起伏，把绳子甩过墙是抛出，heave a sigh 则是把一口气抬出来，也就是叹气。

root: 来自古英语 hebban（举起），属日耳曼语词，与「天空」一词同源；由举起的动作，引申为上下起伏，再引申为用力抛出。

sensesIntro.en: Heave is a heavy lift, a rising and falling motion, or a hard throw.
sensesIntro.cn: heave 是费力的一举、一起一伏的动作，或用力的一抛。

core.en: A back bent under a heavy crate.
core.cn: 一个在重箱下弯下去的背。

branches.en: Two men raise a crate together.
branches.cn: 两个人一起抬起木箱。

branches.en: A runner's chest rises and falls.
branches.cn: 跑者的胸口一起一伏。

branches.en: A rope flies over the wall.
branches.cn: 一根绳子飞过墙头。

branches.en: Lifting makes the breath come harder.
branches.cn: 用力抬起，让呼吸更粗重。

branches.en: The sea lifts a boat, then drops it.
branches.cn: 海把船托起，又把它放下。

intro.en: Heave takes verb endings and builds descriptive and noun forms.
intro.cn: heave 加动词词尾，并构成描写性形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: She heaved a sigh of relief.

definition_en: the home of God in many religions, the sky, or a very pleasant place
core_image: 云层之上光亮开阔的所在，安宁而明亮
scene: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
sceneCN: 这里 heaven 是「天堂」（第 1 个义项）；句意：奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。

senses.title: The home of God
senses.definition: the place where God and good souls are said to live
senses.definitionCN: 宗教中上帝与善者所在之处
senses.example: Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
senses.exampleCN: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。
senses.why: This is the religious sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是宗教意义上的天堂。

senses.title: The sky
senses.definition: the sky, especially in older or poetic use
senses.definitionCN: 天空，尤其用于较古或诗意的表达
senses.example: The stars filled the heavens.
senses.why: Heaven was once simply the sky above.
senses.whyCN: heaven 原本就指头顶的天空。

senses.title: A perfect place
senses.definition: a very pleasant place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 非常舒适愉快的地方或处境
senses.example: This quiet beach is heaven.
senses.exampleCN: 这片安静的海滩就是天堂。
senses.why: Any place that feels perfect borrows the name.
senses.whyCN: 任何让人感到完美的地方，都借用了这个名字。

intro.en: Heaven comes from Old English heofon, the sky.
intro.cn: heaven 来自古英语 heofon，意为天空。

items.en: Heofon named the sky above.
items.cn: heofon 指头顶的天空。

items.en: The word may have meant the lifted roof.
items.cn: 这个词可能本指被抬起的屋顶。

items.en: Heven also named the home of God.
items.cn: 中古英语 heven 也指上帝所在之处。

items.en: The heavens still mean the night sky.
items.cn: the heavens 仍指夜空。

items.en: Any blissful place can be called heaven.
items.cn: 任何极乐之地都可称作 heaven。

note.en: Heaven is compared with look-alike words and with words for a perfect place.
note.cn: 把 heaven 与形近词以及表示美好之地的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heaven begins as the sky and becomes the best place we can imagine.
normalIntro.cn: heaven 从天空开始，最后成了我们能想象的最好地方。

normal.en: They believed he went to heaven.
The heavens were full of stars.
Thank heaven you are safe.
This garden is heaven in summer.
normal.cn: 夏天的这座花园就是天堂。

normal.en: Their teamwork was a match made in heaven.
normal.cn: 他们的合作是天作之合。

abstract.en: Heaven is the sky given a promise.
abstract.cn: 天堂，是被许下承诺的天空。

abstract.en: We build heaven out of what we miss.
abstract.cn: 我们用所缺之物，造出天堂。

abstract.en: A quiet afternoon can open the gate.
abstract.cn: 一个安静的午后，也能推开那扇门。

examples.en: Grandma says kind people go to heaven.
examples.cn: 奶奶说善良的人会去天堂。

examples.en: The stars filled the heavens.
This quiet beach is heaven.
examples.cn: 这片安静的海滩就是天堂。

dict_mnemonic.text: heaven 本是「天空」，宗教把最好的归宿放在天上，于是成了「天堂」；任何舒服得像天堂的地方，也可以直接叫 heaven。

root: 来自古英语 heofon（天空），属日耳曼语词，可能本指「被抬起的屋顶」；由头顶的天空，引申为神灵居所的天堂，再泛指极乐之地。

sensesIntro.en: Heaven is the sky overhead, the promised home of God, and any place that feels perfect.
sensesIntro.cn: heaven 是头顶的天空、应许的神居之所，以及任何完美得像天堂的地方。

core.en: Bright open space above the clouds.
core.cn: 云层之上明亮开阔的地方。

branches.en: A promise is made about the afterlife.
branches.cn: 人们许下关于身后归宿的承诺。

branches.en: Stars fill the night above.
branches.cn: 星星布满头顶的夜空。

branches.en: A hammock sways by the sea.
branches.cn: 吊床在海边轻轻摇晃。

branches.en: The sky above becomes the home beyond.
branches.cn: 头顶的天，成了远方的家。

branches.en: A perfect day feels like open sky.
branches.cn: 完美的一天，像敞开的天空。

intro.en: Heaven builds an adjective, an adverb, and a plural.
intro.cn: heaven 构成形容词、副词与复数形式。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root in the everyday word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个日常词没有拉丁词根。

items.meaning: the sky or home of God

items.example: They believe he is in heaven.

definition_en: in a heavy way, in large amounts, or to a serious degree
core_image: 雨点密集砸下，走路的人被压得弯下肩
scene: 雨下得很大。It was raining heavily.
sceneCN: 这里 heavily 是「大量地」（第 2 个义项）；句意：雨下得很大。

senses.title: With weight
senses.definition: in a way that shows weight or effort
senses.definitionCN: 显出重量或费力地
senses.example: He walked heavily up the stairs.
senses.why: The body carries weight here.
senses.whyCN: 这里身体承载着重量。

senses.title: In large amounts
senses.definition: in large amounts or with great force
senses.definitionCN: 数量很大或力度很强地
senses.example: It was raining heavily.
senses.why: Rain falls in heavy drops.
senses.whyCN: 雨以沉重的雨点落下。

senses.title: To a serious degree
senses.definition: to a great or serious degree
senses.definitionCN: 达到很大或严重的程度
senses.example: The town was heavily damaged by the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 这座镇子被洪水严重破坏。
senses.why: The effect presses down like a weight.
senses.whyCN: 影响像重量一样压下来。

intro.en: Heavily is heavy plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: heavily 由 heavy 加副词后缀 -ly 构成。

items.en: Hefig meant heavy or weighed down.
items.cn: hefig 意为重的、被压住的。

items.en: Hevy kept the sense of weight.
items.cn: 中古英语 hevy 仍指重量。

items.en: Heavily first described moving with weight.
items.cn: heavily 起初描写带着重量移动。

items.en: It widened to mean in large amounts.
items.cn: 词义扩展到数量很大。

items.en: It also came to mean seriously or greatly.
items.cn: 也表示严重地、在很大程度上。

note.en: Heavily is compared with look-alike words and with words for strong degree.
note.cn: 把 heavily 与形近词以及表示程度强的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Heavily turns weight into a way of doing things.
normalIntro.cn: heavily 把重量变成了一种做事的方式。

normal.en: It rained heavily all night.

scene: 救援直升机把伤员送下山。A rescue helicopter carried the injured man down the mountain.
sceneCN: 这里 helicopter 是「直升机」（第 1 个义项）；句意：救援直升机把伤员送下山。

senses.title: The aircraft
senses.definition: an aircraft with large spinning blades that can fly straight up
senses.definitionCN: 带大型旋转桨叶、能垂直起飞的飞行器
senses.example: A rescue helicopter carried the injured man down the mountain.
senses.exampleCN: 救援直升机把伤员送下山。
senses.why: This is the machine itself.
senses.whyCN: 这是机器本身。

senses.title: Carry by air
senses.definition: to carry someone or something by helicopter
senses.definitionCN: 用直升机运送人或物
senses.example: They helicoptered food to the flooded village.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用直升机把食物运到被淹的村子。
senses.why: The noun becomes the action of using it.
senses.whyCN: 名词在这里变成了使用它的动作。

intro.en: Helicopter joins Greek helix, spiral, and pteron, wing.
intro.cn: helicopter 由希腊语 helix（螺旋）与 pteron（翼）合成。

items.en: Helix meant a spiral.
items.cn: helix 意为螺旋。

items.en: Pteron meant a wing.
items.cn: pteron 意为翼。

items.en: Hélicoptère combined the two ideas.
items.cn: 法语 hélicoptère 把这两个意思合在一起。

items.en: Helicopter named the new flying machine.
items.cn: helicopter 成为这种新飞行器的名称。

items.en: The word became a verb meaning to fly someone out.
items.cn: 这个词又变成动词，表示用直升机运送。

note.en: Helicopter is compared with words sharing its heli- shape and with other aircraft words.
note.cn: 把 helicopter 与带 heli- 形式的词以及其他飞行器词作比较。

entries.definition: an informal word for a helicopter

normalIntro.en: Helicopter is a spiral wing that lifts straight up.
normalIntro.cn: helicopter 是一片能把机身垂直提起来的螺旋之翼。

normal.en: The helicopter landed on the roof.
They sent a helicopter to the island.
normal.cn: 他们派了一架直升机去岛上。

normal.en: The pilot flew the helicopter low.
normal.cn: 飞行员把直升机飞得很低。

normal.en: He was helicoptered to the hospital.
Helicopter parents watch every step.
normal.cn: 直升机父母盯着孩子的每一步。

abstract.en: A helicopter argues with gravity and wins.
abstract.cn: 直升机与重力争辩，并且赢了。

abstract.en: Its wing goes around so the body can go up.
abstract.cn: 翅膀绕圈，机身才能上升。

abstract.en: Some care hovers like a rotor, never landing.
abstract.cn: 有些关心像旋翼一样悬着，从不落地。

examples.en: A rescue helicopter carried the injured man down the mountain.
examples.cn: 救援直升机把伤员送下山。

examples.en: They helicoptered food to the flooded village.
examples.cn: 他们用直升机把食物运到被淹的村子。

examples.en: The helicopter landed on the roof.

dict_mnemonic.text: helicopter 拆开是「螺旋」加「翼」：靠头顶旋转的翼垂直升降；把它当动词用，就是用直升机把人或物运走。

root: 由希腊语 helix（螺旋）与 pteron（翼）经法语 hélicoptère 进入英语；命名依据是它头顶旋转的桨叶，后来也作动词表示用直升机运送。

sensesIntro.en: Helicopter names the rotor aircraft, and then the act of carrying someone by it.
sensesIntro.cn: helicopter 指这种旋翼飞行器，再指用它运送人的动作。

core.en: Blades spinning above a rising body.
core.cn: 旋翼在上升的机身上方飞转。

branches.en: The machine rises straight up.
branches.cn: 机器垂直升起。

branches.en: Supplies fly to a cut-off town.
branches.cn: 物资飞向与外界隔绝的城镇。

branches.en: A pilot hovers above the roof.
branches.cn: 飞行员在屋顶上方悬停。

branches.en: The aircraft becomes a flying ambulance.
branches.cn: 飞行器成了空中救护车。

branches.en: To helicopter someone out is to save time and lives.
branches.cn: 用直升机运人出去，是抢回时间与生命。

intro.en: Helicopter is built from Greek roots and forms verb endings.
intro.cn: helicopter 由希腊词根构成，并加动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: The roots are Greek, not Latin: helix and pteron.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词根是希腊语而非拉丁语：helix 与 pteron。

items.exampleCN: 他们用直升机把他运了出去。

items.meaning: the act of flying by helicopter
items.exampleCN: 用直升机运物资成本很高。

items.example: The helipad is on the roof.

items.exampleCN: 直升机机场去年启用了。
